name: export_parameter_bindings
description: Project: export the project's parameter bindings and full shared-parameter inventory to a JSON file ON DISK. Per binding: name, isInstance, group, dataType (spec id), boundCategories, guid (for shared params), isShared. Also includes allSharedParameterElements (name + guid) — the complete shared-param set (CONTROL_MARK, MANUFACTURE_COMPONENT, CONSTRUCTION_PRODUCT_HOST, BOM_PRODUCT_HOST, …). Only a summary returns through MCP. outputPath is a caller-supplied absolute path.
